P1.3.text: With multiple campuses and schools serving diverse communities, Legacy Education is shaping the future of healthcare one student at a time.

P1.4.text: By offering a wide range of award winning educational programs, we provide students with a marketable path to achieve their professional goals and strive for a legacy of excellence.

P1.6.text: Discover how each of our colleges is creating positive change in their local communities.

P1.7.text: Gain a deeper understanding of the trends shaping today’s workforce.

P1.8.text: What if you woke up every morning looking forward to supporting someone on their Path to Purpose? Join Legacy Education and you can make an impact in the lives of students, staff and a community for a greater tomorrow.

P2.1.text: About Legacy Education | Accredited Allied Health Colleges

P2.2.text: Meet Legacy Education: nationally accredited, award-winning allied health programs at 4 schools on 6 campuses. Explore our mission, values, and approvals.

P2.3.text: Headquartered in Lancaster, California, we proudly own and operate 4 schools on 6 campuses. By offering a wide range of award-winning educational programs, we provide post-secondary students with a marketable path to achieve their professional goals and strive for a legacy of excellence.

P2.4.text: Through our outstanding programs and expert leadership, we are committed to growing our educational footprint through organic enrollment growth, program expansion, and acquisitions.

P2.5.text: Integrity – By constantly striving for the best in education, we remain true to our mission, our vision, and our commitment to students, faculty, staff and investors.

P2.6.text: These qualities nourish our venture and drive us forward in achieving our goals.

P2.7.text: Creativity – Our inventive spirits and industrious imaginations fuel our efforts to consistently situate the company on the leading edge of its field, and offer the latest innovations in instructional techniques and technologies.

P2.8.text: Teamwork – While we started with a close-knit, loyal group of educators, more than 30 years ago, its true legacy will be the spirit of constructive collaboration it inspires in its students, faculty and staff.

P2.9.text: All Legacy Education colleges are licensed by the Bureau for Private Postsecondary Education (BPPE). Licensed to operate means the institution is in compliance with the state standards as set forth in the California Private Postsecondary Education Act of 2009, Ed. Code §94897.

P2.10.text: The Licensed Vocational Nursing programs at all Legacy Education colleges are approved by the California Board of Vocational Nursing and Psychiatric Technicians (BVNPT).

P2.11.text: The Veterinary Technology program at Central Coast College has been awarded full Accreditation by the Council on Veterinary Technical Education and Activities of the American Veterinary Medical Association – AVMA.

P2.12.text: The MRI & Ultrasound Tech programs at High Desert Medical College are approved by the American Registry of Radiologic Technologists (ARRT).

P2.13.text: Integrity College of Health maintains Institutional Accreditation with the Accrediting Bureau of Health Education Schools (ABHES).

P2.14.text: The RN-BSN program at ICH is programmatically accredited by NLN Commission for Nursing Education Accreditation (NLN CNEA).

P2.15.text: The Integrity College of Health Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing Program holds initial accreditation from the National League for Nursing Commission for Nursing Education Accreditation (NLN CNEA)

P2.16.text: LeeAnn Rohmann founded Legacy Education to support her strong belief in higher education as the basis for building a legacy for students and their families. She is passionate about providing the best training in the strongest industries like healthcare.

P2.17.text: Legacy Education wins the 2025 CECU Community Impact Award

P2.18.text: Claudia Barajas of Legacy Education wins the 2025 Norma Ford Financial Aid Professional of the Year

P2.19.text: Legacy Education receives the 2022 CAPPS Excellence in Community Service Award

P2.20.text: Legacy Education wins 2020 CAPPS School of the Year

P1.1.text: Technical Trade School | Universal Technical Institute

P1.2.text: UTI offers hands-on programs in automotive, diesel, welding, HVACR, and more. Discover your future at a leading trade school.

P1.3.text: Getting started is easy! Just take 60 seconds to fill out the form.

P1.4.text: 5 Ways Students May Help Fund Their Training

P1.5.text: Paying for training isn’t one-size-fits-all. Universal Technical Institute has helped thousands of students build personalized funding plans, and we can help build yours too.

P1.6.text: Pell Grants, student loans, & Parent PLUS loans can help bridge the gap.

P1.7.text: UTI has institutional, relocation, commuter and other grant opportunities. 10

P1.8.text: Apply through UTI, Scholarship Universe & TechForce—even while enrolled! 10

P1.9.text: Some employers may offer repayment help or other incentives to grads they hire. 14

P1.10.text: Some students can pursue roles in the field before graduating 36

P1.11.text: UTI Trade School: Training Built for Your Future

P1.12.text: You’ve got goals, and we’re here to help you reach them. 1 At Universal Technical Institute (UTI), you can prepare for your future faster than a 4-year college. Explore how we can help make it happen.

P1.13.text: Get a Firsthand Look at UTI

P1.14.text: Picture yourself in a supportive student community at a technical training school where small classes encourage focused learning. In hands-on labs, passionate instructors will guide you in using the same tools and equipment as techs in the field. 18 You’ll tackle challenges that mirror the real world while developing skills to get closer to where you want to be. See it for yourself.

P1.17.text: UTI’s vocational trade school can help you gain the skills and confidence to pursue what you love.

P1.19.text: Explore answers to common questions about our technical school programs and admissions.

P1.20.text: Tips, success stories and industry info.

P2.2.text: Universal Technical Institute, Inc. is a leading provider of technical training in trades from automotive to welding.

P2.3.text: Approximately 285,000 students have graduated from UTI's campuses located across the U.S.

P2.4.text: To change the world one life at a time by helping people achieve their dreams. This is the underlying reason for our existence and the reason we come to work every day.

P2.6.text: Our reputation is the basis of our growing brand. Making our brand more powerful is essential to achieving our vision.

P2.8.text: We embrace change and continuous improvement.

P2.9.text: We deliver meaningful outcomes for our students and stakeholders.
